text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way home together— Tanino Gimlet 
mentioned that there was somewhere she 
wanted to stop by.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The temple of wisdom—the path to the 
academy lies just ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The halls of learning"... Does that mean 
a school? If it's referred to as a temple 
of wisdom, it wouldn't be an elementary or 
middle school, but surely not...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What is it, Trainer? Do you wish to 
sharpen your knowledge as well? 
Then—follow me!

text_block_list.name: University Professor
text_block_list.text:
—In short, the ego's role is to mediate 
between the id and the superego—the 
unconscious and the higher self—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It turned out Tanino Gimlet's goal was a 
public lecture open to the community. We 
listened thoroughly to a very serious 
talk!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
O Wise One, regarding that lecture just 
now—

text_block_list.name: University Professor
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's you! Thank you for always 
listening so intently. Which part caught 
your interest?
choice_data_list:
(They're on familiar terms with the 
Professor...!?)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I suppose there's no choice but to say 
there are many theories regarding the 
existence of other minds.

text_block_list.name: University Professor
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I think I touched upon Descartes' 
problem of other minds in class, but I 
really recommend this book if you want to 
dive deeper into it.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... You have my gratitude. That was a 
fruitful time. May the God of Wisdom guide 
your path!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Tanino Gimlet had something she 
wanted to do even after finishing college—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The tome indicated by the wise one... Is 
this it? ...Hm?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, a translation of the Dead Sea 
Scrolls! Immersing myself in a sea of 
records for a fleeting moment isn't bad at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I bought a few sophisticated-looking books 
at a book cafe she frequents, and—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It was not a bad play. The tragedy of the 
Maiden of Revelation and the Victorious 
King... Excessive honor can indeed turn to 
poison, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Entering the theater, watching a play 
themed around heroes and history—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We decided to eat dinner before heading 
back to the academy, but...
choice_data_list:
(I never thought a detour could be so 
intellectual...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While I was admiring Tanino Gimlet's 
cultured side――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Thou hast not yet touched thy sustenance? 
Heh... 'Tis just like the 'ego' binding 
the 'unconscious.'"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
However, reaching out unconsciously isn't 
bad once in a while. Perhaps that might 
become your "Qumran"!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The ego that binds the unconscious mind 
is, to one another, both poison and 
remedy.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes, just like the "Maiden" of the Castle 
of Chinon...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet was spouting his usual 
cryptic lines, but... I suddenly realized 
something. This sequence of words was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I heard about the concept of the ego in a 
university lecture I sat in on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Qumran is the place where the Dead Sea 
Scrolls, the book Cafe was reading, were 
first discovered.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both Château de Chinon and Jeanne must be 
words related to the 'Joan of Arc' play I 
saw on stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Weren't all of those words you learned 
today? Could today's study session have 
been—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—You may interpret it that way. But 
essentially... it is to make my brilliance 
shine even brighter!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Because— learning is the origin of 
everything!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... The knowledge accumulated 
through my studies only makes my 
brilliance shine all the brighter!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
This world is truly like Pelion itself!! 
Everything begins with learning, and to 
learning it all returns!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —That is why learning is beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her attitude of learning for the sake of 
her own aesthetic is truly magnificent.
choice_data_list:
You studied so hard all day today, well 
done!

You studied so hard all day today, good 
job!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her attitude of learning for the sake of 
her own aesthetic is truly magnificent.
choice_data_list:
You studied so hard all day today, well 
done!

You studied so hard all day today, good 
job!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to convey how genuinely impressed 
I was, I gave her straightforward praise 
for today's studying!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Fufufu! Naturally!! It is only 
logical and true that my radiance shines 
ever brighter!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you too shall receive... the 
divine guidance of the God of Wisdom!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet gave a triumphant smile. Her 
ability to accept compliments honestly is 
one of her great qualities.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It turned into an invaluable day where I 
caught a glimpse of where her vast wealth 
of knowledge comes from!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I studied with her today, so I tried 
channeling my inner Tanino Gimlet... and 
used some of the new vocabulary I learned!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh... hehe... BWAAAH-HA-HA-HA-HA-HA!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's your move!! Splendid, I 
can feel our souls resonating...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Let us share a cup, the night is still 
young... I shall bestow upon you a 
fragment of this wisdom.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet was eager to show off his 
knowledge... but since dorm curfew was 
approaching, I politely declined.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Regardless, it was a valuable day where 
I caught a glimpse of where her wealth of 
knowledge comes from!
